title: What chunk size should I use?
body: Start at 500 tokens with 75 tokens of overlap, then measure. Corpora made of short reference entries often do better at 250-300 tokens, while narrative documentation frequently benefits from 700-900.

title: Why do my chunks mix unrelated topics?
body: A fixed-size splitter has no idea where a section ends. Use the structural or recursive strategy so that chunk boundaries follow the document outline instead of a character counter.

title: Should I include the heading in the chunk text?
body: Yes. A chunk retrieved in isolation should say what it is about. RAG ChunkForge repeats the section heading in every chunk of that section and can also add a context prefix with the full heading path.

title: How much overlap is too much?
body: Above roughly 25 percent of the target size you are mostly paying to store and embed the same sentences twice. Overlap at sentence boundaries rather than by raw character count.

title: Do I need embeddings to use this tool?
body: No. The chunking pipeline is complete without them. Embeddings are an optional final stage behind a provider interface so you can plug in sentence-transformers, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
